import json
# Determine output bar for each shape. Shapes: corner shapes at various positions in left half (cols 0-6).
# Each shape maps to a bar (horizontal or vertical line) of the same color, placed within the output's left half (cols 0-6).

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    g=G[name+' input']; o_=G[name+' output']
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] in (0,4): continue
            q=[(i,j)]; seen={(i,j)}; comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy in(-1,0,1):
                    for dx in(-1,0,1):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and (ny,nx) not in seen and g[ny][nx] not in (0,4):
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            rs=[y for y,x in comp]; cs=[x for y,x in comp]
            comps.append(comp)
    print('===',name,'shapes:')
    for comp in comps:
        col=g[comp[0][0]][comp[0][1]]
        rs=[y for y,x in comp]; cs=[x for y,x in comp]
        print(f'  {col} n={len(comp)} bbox=(r{min(rs)}-{max(rs)}, c{min(cs)}-{max(cs)}) cells={sorted(comp)}')
    print('   bars:')
    for i,row in enumerate(o_):
        j=0
        while j<len(row):
            if row[j]!=0:
                k=j
                while k<len(row) and row[k]==row[j]: k+=1
                cells=[(i,x) for x in range(j,k)]
                print(f'  color{row[j]} n={len(cells)} row={cells}')
                j=k
            else: j+=1
